scope: Prepare and independently validate one paired 96-trial software plan for the two frozen LocalSim-augmented ACT checkpoints on the exact existing Eval48 pose bank. Stop before opening serial, camera, robot, torque, or starting any policy window.

execution_contract.action_path: raw=requested then SO101Follower.send_action, recording official sent and upstream modification mask
execution_contract.replacement_rule: only policy_window_never_started, confirmed_operator_placement_error, or infrastructure_error; preserve original evidence and allow at most one linked replacement

software_gate_checks: recompute and match both checkpoint, processor, training-result, pose-manifest, and source-plan hashes
expand all 96 trial identities deterministically and verify 48 complete pairs with balanced first-model order
verify ACT chunk_size and n_action_steps are 67 and input/output schemas are front640x480 plus state6 to action6
run one bounded CUDA offline finite-action inference per checkpoint
run fake 96-trial execution covering ready, policy reset, official-send path, 30-second no-catch-up timing, evidence schema, and failure-preserving replacement semantics
freeze the software plan, dry-run, hash inventory, and independent validation

historical_baseline.model: ACT Real24 budget extension seed1000 step100000

next_user_contact_if_software_gate_passe: Ask for explicit onsite hardware GO, unchanged Real camera/grid setup, Follower 12V on, and placement of the first frozen Eval48 pose. Do not ask the user to wait for further software preparation.
prohibited: open serial, camera, robot, torque, or 12V
start a real or simulation policy rollout
change checkpoint, pose bank, pose order, action processing, timeout, success rule, or camera
add another model, seed, tuning condition, or safety/action limiter
claim_boundary: Software preparation and offline inference do not establish real policy performance or Sim-to-Real benefit.
